source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release 1.6.45-CE-ubuntu24.04-r6 was cut (2026-11-20T07:51:45Z), by scripts/retarget.py --rev-bump: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit 2d51e364799b, dated 2026-07-10T04:11:54Z (source.commit_epoch).
source._build_note: The git tag has no configure script: autogen.sh (aclocal, autoheader, automake, autoconf) makes it in the vendor stage, where .git is still present, because version.pl reads the version from `git describe`; the check after it refuses a tree whose version.m4 is not 1.6.45 (an UNKNOWN version would ship a binary that reports it). The offline build runs ./configure, make and make install from that tree into /opt/memcached. --enable-tls builds TLS against Ubuntu's OpenSSL (libssl-dev; libssl3t64 at runtime); it is off until memcached is started with -Z. SASL is not built (upstream's image builds it with libsasl2, which adds Cyrus SASL and Berkeley DB to the image); memcached's own ASCII authentication (-Y <file>) needs no library. Measured 2026-11-08 on ubuntu:24.04: autogen, configure, make and make install in about 40 s; `memcached -V` prints `memcached 1.6.45`; the binary links libevent-2.1.so.7, libssl.so.3, libcrypto.so.3 and glibc. gcc honours SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for __DATE__ and __TIME__.
